exposure: Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant Disaster
food purchasing patterns (proxy for evacuation and radiation-related anxiety)
cohort: Participants included 1101 live singleton births at a public hospital located 23 km from the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, from 2008 to 2015.
finding: No increased proportions of low birthweight or preterm births were found in any year after the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant Disaster, and no significant associations were identified between birth outcomes and residential area or food purchasing patterns.
